sources.provider: Purdue University official campus map / BuildingShapes ArcGIS FeatureServer
sources.source_crs: FeatureServer native EPSG:3857; preserved query snapshot returned EPSG:4326
sources.supports: HARR / Benjamin Harrison Residence Hall / 107 Macarthur Drive and the exterior plan polygon.
sources.independent_measurement: 28 distinct source vertices projected using the repository's local meters-per-degree conversion, with manifest placement origin applied; symmetric nearest-vertex difference against evaluated HARR_Ground_Plinth_Base = 0.000561099 m.
sources.uncertainty: Campus-map data is not a certified survey; it does not support facade or elevation dimensions.

sources.provider: Purdue University Office of Emergency Preparedness
sources.supports: Three major wings; north and south wings are 8 stories; center section is 2 stories.
sources.uncertainty: No total height, roof elevation, floor datum or measured floor-to-floor data.

sources.supports: Opened in 1966; two wings connected by central common areas; street address 107 MacArthur Drive. The HTML declares a gallery identifier but does not embed or describe facade images.
sources.uncertainty: The page has no measured elevations or exterior dimensions.

sources.provider: Purdue University Residences official gallery feed
sources.supports: Feed metadata identifies a Harrison Hall Gallery and lists official image filenames from 2021; it is provenance for source image availability only.
sources.uncertainty: This grade did not fetch or visually compare the remote photos; filename metadata is not architectural evidence.

sources.provider: Purdue University Residences Past ABCD Award Winners page
sources.supports: The winner list states a February 2024 Harrison Hall employee award.
sources.does_not_support: It does not identify an exterior photo of the Harrison Hall entrance; the builder evidence record's statement to that effect is overstated.

visual_review.method: Human visual review of fresh renders generated by running the copied canonical builder in an isolated replica. These renders document the model but are not independent facade references.
visual_review.observed: Two taller wings, lower central section, brick pattern, window bands, entrance canopy/sign and west screen are modeled.
visual_review.unverified: External facade material/colors, exact window module spacing, entrance proportions, solar-screen dimensions, vertical scale, roof geometry.
